title: Cyrus Permits the Return

questions.question: In whose first year did the LORD stir up the spirit of Cyrus king of Persia?
questions.explanation: Ezra 1:1 (ESV): "In the first year of Cyrus king of Persia..."

questions.question: Whose word by the mouth of the LORD was being fulfilled?
questions.explanation: Ezra 1:1 (ESV): "...that the word of the LORD by the mouth of Jeremiah might be fulfilled..."

questions.question: What did Cyrus say the LORD charged him to do?
options: Build him a house at Jerusalem
questions.correctAnswer: Build him a house at Jerusalem
questions.explanation: Ezra 1:2 (ESV): "...he has charged me to build him a house at Jerusalem, which is in Judah."

questions.question: Who encouraged those who went up to Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: Ezra 1:6 (ESV): "And all who were about them aided them with vessels of silver, with gold..."

questions.question: What did Cyrus bring out that Nebuchadnezzar had taken?
options: The vessels of the house of the LORD
questions.correctAnswer: The vessels of the house of the LORD
questions.explanation: Ezra 1:7 (ESV): "Cyrus the king also brought out the vessels of the house of the LORD that Nebuchadnezzar had carried away..."

questions.question: To whom were the vessels counted out?
questions.explanation: Ezra 1:8 (ESV): "...who counted them out to Sheshbazzar the prince of Judah."

questions.question: Who was the treasurer that counted the vessels?
questions.explanation: Ezra 1:8 (ESV): "...Cyrus king of Persia had them given to Mithredath the treasurer..."

questions.question: How many basins of gold were there?
How many basins of silver were there?
What was the total number of vessels of gold and silver?
questions.explanation: Ezra 1:11 (ESV): "All the vessels of gold and of silver were 5,400."

questions.question: Where is Jerusalem located according to the text?
questions.explanation: Ezra 1:2 (ESV): "...at Jerusalem, which is in Judah."

questions.question: What besides vessels and precious things did the neighbors assist with?
questions.explanation: Ezra 1:6 (ESV): "...with goods, with beasts, and with costly wares..."

questions.question: Where had Nebuchadnezzar placed the vessels?
options: In the house of his gods
questions.correctAnswer: In the house of his gods
questions.explanation: Ezra 1:7 (ESV): "...and placed in the house of his gods."

questions.question: How many silver censers were there?
From where did Sheshbazzar bring the vessels up?
questions.explanation: Ezra 1:11 (ESV): "All these did Sheshbazzar bring up, when the exiles were brought up from Babylonia to Jerusalem."

key_verse_text: Whoever is among you of all his people, may his God be with him, and let him go up to Jerusalem, which is in Judah, and rebuild the house of the LORD, the God of Israel—he is the God who is in Jerusalem.
